recordedFrom.note: The runner prints its result object to stdout and writes nothing durable. This bundle is that object, verbatim, from one disposable native-local run driven by the launcher the gate table resolves for the action (`tools/run-stardew-native-local-player-move-fixture.ps1 -Action fish_here`), on commit d43ff405. A second, independent run of the same commit from `tools/live-action.mjs --action fish_here --keep-log` (.tmp/fish/live7.json, state=passed, reasonCode=fish_caught, target water_254b7a3116211750, tile 72,30, fish_caught 0->1, bait 20->19, stamina -8, 30834 ms, restore problems []) agreed on every field the two share. No earlier run of this action had ever been read as a pass: the first real receipt (2026-11-14, before 834aabb0) was `succeeded/fish_caught` while the runner reported `blocked fish_here_evidence_was_perfect:missing:true`, and .tmp/fish/live-1..live-5 record the five blocked slices that between them produced the runner's dry-tile refusal, its off-map coordinate and its `not_measured` parity answer.

whatThisProves: The Mod drove the game's own cast at the nearest water tile the engine published: `Farm` tile 72,30, target `water_254b7a3116211750`, receipt `succeeded/fish_caught` at revision 2 with `hasEvidence=true`. The trace shows the request ACCEPTED at revision 1 first, so the terminal is the same execution's settlement and not a re-read of the accepted receipt.

The catch is the engine's own credit, not the action's narration: `fish_caught_before=0` -> `fish_caught_after=1`, `fish_caught_delta=1`, `credit=fishCaught:0->1` - exactly one fish booked by `Farmer.caughtFish`'s own win path - and it arrived in the pack (`inventory_before=0` -> `inventory_after=1`).

The species, size and quality are the ENGINE's draw, not an argument: `(O)145` 太阳鱼, `fish_size=8`, `quality=0`, chosen by `GameLocation.getFish` at the bite (`bite_observed=isNibbling`, `cast_to_credit_ms=1612`). Nothing in the request names a species.

The cast cost what a cast costs, from the engine's own mutations: bait 20 -> 19 (`(O)685` armed by the fixture in the rod), stamina 270 -> 262 (`stamina_delta=-8`), and the rod's durability answer present (`rod_durability_left=-1`).

The pull's own outcome is NOT claimed: `pull_outcome=not_verified` with the field it could not watch named (`BobberBar.distanceFromCatching`). A receipt that said `verified` would be a violation of the same gate.

A request whose `expectedTargetId` names another tile was refused BY NAME before the rig was touched: `water_not_fishable:target_changed`, evidence `target=water_f05b58f51f879411;tile=72,30;actual=water_254b7a3116211750`, revision 3, and no catch was booked. A handler that cast whatever it was handed would make the positive half meaningless.

`fish_here` at a tile the map does not contain (1000,1000) is a NAMED REFUSAL, not a cast: `no_cuttable_blocker:water` at revision 4, evidence `actor=73,30;reach=1;standable_neighbour=none;approaches=north:off_map,east:off_map,south:off_map,west:off_map;blocked_by=range:reach:970`, with no catch and no stamina spent.
The reader's parity half answered `not_measured` (reason `location_overrides_get_fish:Farm`, `sampled=0`) instead of reading as agreement - the third answer, not a quiet pass.
whatThisDoesNotProve: The reader-against-engine parity claim is ABSENT, not satisfied: `parity.status=not_measured`, `sampled=0`, because Farm is one of the five locations whose own `getFish` override means `FishingCatchable` refuses to publish a set at all. Nothing here says our published set contains every species the engine can return, and the reverse direction (we publish a species the engine never returns) is not claimed even where sampling runs.

The two specific-bait cases were NOT driven. This world arms plain `(O)685` (20) in the rod, and no published action replaces a rod's bait, so neither `(O)SpecificBait` naming a species present in this location's rows nor one naming an absent species was exercised. See `not_measured` in the task's report: arming it needs a scenario variant in `integrations/stardew/ModEntry.Fixtures.ScenarioInitializers.Containers.cs`, which is outside this unit's files.
One location (`Farm`), one season/day/hour (spring 1 Y1, morning), one weather. Species whose rows the conditions exclude are not exercised.
No cancellation, deadline expiry, uncertain outcome, replay, save/reload or Farmhand (shared-world) coverage.

The dry-tile case names a tile the map does not contain, not an in-map land tile: the actor is boxed in by water on all four sides in this fixture, so no adjacent in-map tile can produce `water_not_fishable:not_water`, and `(-1,-1)` is refused by the bridge's argument range before any handler runs.
